reconstruction_summary: Re-ran the agent's recommended V2 per-platform model — pred = gain * (yaw_rate_pred_rads - bias) — using bias/gain coefficients read from out/ablate_FORD_*_*.json (Mustang: bias=7.539e-4, gain=1.06868; F-150: bias=4.422e-3, gain=0.85921).
notes: Agent shipped per-platform coefficients (PARAM_BY_PLATFORM); both Ford platforms have entries so the model applies cleanly across the canonical Ford eval set. Coefficients were fitted on every-5th-sample interleaved test/train split over the same Ford segments, so canonical scoring includes some training overlap (accepted per the leakage_note). baseline_rmse_recomputed matches canonical V0 to ~1e-15.
